title: Tranquil Suburban Home with English Gardens in Atlanta, Georgia
description:
Presented by Atlanta Fine Homes Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to http://goo.gl/qRp3Rq

Must see inside to appreciate this renovated Sandy Springs beauty where peace and tranquility meet suburban lifestyle. This gated brick home with automated entry boasts extraordinary living spaces including spectacular owner's retreat, outdoor dining and living room, large library with bookshelves, enormous dining room and separate living room with bar. Kitchen area is complete with double ovens, walk in pantry with ice maker and gas range overlooking views of pool and gardens. Terrace level has kitchen, full pool bath, movie room and gym with mirrored wall.
